$comment: Reference record schema for references.jsonl. Validated by scripts/library.py (rules beyond this file live there: score only on inspected records; AI classification requires evidence; https URLs only).

fields.id: REF-0001 style, assigned by `library.py add` when set to "auto"
fields.title: project title exactly as published
fields.creator: person/studio as credited on the original page; null if not verified
fields.url: original project URL actually found (never constructed or guessed)
fields.platform: behance | dribbble | pinterest | instagram | portfolio | publication | foundry | other
fields.published: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD if shown on the page
fields.status: lead (named in a search result only) | search-verified (title+creator+URL confirmed by a search index, page not inspected) | inspected (images and text actually viewed) | broken (URL dead/renamed)
fields.production_method: human | ai-generated | hybrid | ai-assisted-documented | resembles-ai-unverified | unverified
fields.production_evidence: quote or description of the creator's own statement/process material; required for any AI or hybrid classification
problems_solved: free text: e.g. 'bilingual lockup parity', 'dense info at small size', 'campaign variation without drift'

observations.typography: type categories; name a font only if documented

indicators.diversity_note: what this adds that other records do not

key_lessons: transferable principle, phrased as a decision rule
do_not_copy: context-specific or signature elements that must not be reproduced
fields.source_note: how this record was obtained (tool + what was and was not seen)
